realm.name: billing
realm.description: Access to the Billing App and billing-relevant patient/claims data only (charges, insurance/claims status, payment records); explicitly no access to clinical notes in the EHR Simulator.

realm.name: nurse
realm.description: Supporting clinical access. Illustrates a least-privilege distinction between two clinical roles with overlapping but not identical access.

realm.name: hr
realm.description: Access to the HR App and workforce records (employee records, onboarding/offboarding status, role assignments); no access to any patient-facing application (Patient Portal, EHR Simulator, Billing App)

realm.name: vendor
realm.description: External/third-party access, narrowly scoped to a specific system or time-limited engagement (e.g., a specific application module or a defined support period), with the shortest expected access lifespan of all seven roles.

realm.name: it-support
realm.description: Administrative/helpdesk access: ability to view user account status and assist with access issues (e.g., password resets) but not standing access to clinical, billing, or HR data itself.

realm.name: clinician
realm.description: Front-line care provider access. Represents the role with the broadest ePHI access.

realm.name: security-analyst
realm.description: Access to security monitoring and logging tools (SIEM, authentication logs, Keycloak Events) across the environment for investigation purposes, but not standing operational access to patient, billing, or HR application data itself.

passwordPolicy: length(10) and upperCase(1) and lowerCase(1) and digits(1) and specialChars(1) and passwordHistory(3)

clientScopes.description: OpenID Connect scope for add user roles to the access token
